summary:
Reviewed a807b5b7 (same change as the reported 4f878184). For a glossary-proposal, a gate round with no question now gets one question asking approval of the terms it adds, changes and removes (r173). The r117 capability wording is unchanged.
No test removed or weakened, no features/ change, no allowances claimed. vulture clean, no contracts, size clean; ruff findings are all in lines the commit did not touch.
Two Minor observations: a proposal whose three lists are all empty gets 'It .', and ids not of the form term/<x> are cut by a fixed length.
